confidence_notes: Low confidence: five price searches returned mostly Cuba-wide or Havana-level secondary figures (crowd-sourced Numbeo Havana data, travel-budget guides, a few Trinidad-focused guides) and no Trinidad aggregate index with usable figures, so food and drink anchors are triangulated for tourist-facing, USD-linked venues. Beer is a standard domestic bottle/can serving (true draft is rare); cocktail is about 1.5x beer, in line with the $3-5 mojito/cocktail ranges found; no per-glass wine price was found, so wine_glass is set relative to beer and cocktail (about 1.75x beer). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge (casa-particular-dominated market, few true hostels); no listings were inspected. Cuba's multiple exchange rates and USD-versus-CUP pricing add uncertainty. The latest RBA observation found was 2026-11-18; a 2026-11-19 value could not be confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Havana crowd-sourced Numbeo figures were used as the low bound and Cuba/Trinidad travel-budget guide ranges (beer $2-4, cocktails $3-5, paladar meals about $6-15) as the tourist-venue bound; one search result noted Trinidad's private restaurants cost less than Havana's. Accommodation is judged against a casa-particular-dominated colonial tourist town with a few 3-star hotels.
